name: AC Transit: East Bay Paratransit
description: Door-to-door transit for AC Transit/BART service area
fullDescription: East Bay Paratransit, run jointly by AC Transit and BART, is a shared-ride, door-to-door service for people who are unable to use AC Transit or BART due to a disability. It serves areas within 3/4 mile of an operating AC Transit bus route or BART station, mainly in Alameda and western Contra Costa counties.
whatTheyOffer:
- Door-to-door shared ride service
- Service area covers AC Transit and BART service areas, during their operating hours
- Reservations taken 1-7 days in advance (no same-day trips)
- Fares from $4 to $7 within the East Bay; $6 to $10 to or from San Francisco
- Free rides for personal care attendants
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Call 510-287-5000 or visit actransit.org/paratransit for an application
2. Complete the written application
3. An in-person interview is part of the eligibility process
4. Once certified, call 510-287-5000 (8 am-5 pm daily) by 5 pm the day before to book rides
keywords: paratransit, ADA, East Bay, AC Transit, BART, disability, wheelchair, door to door, Oakland, Berkeley
